scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @contributorops/api" "npm run dev --workspace @contributorops/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @contributorops/api && npm run build --workspace @contributorops/web
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace @contributorops/api && npm run build --workspace @contributorops/web && npm run site:build
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/api && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../site && npx tsc --noEmit
